text: Look closely at The Night Watch. Behind the captain is a small, bright figure: a girl with a chicken hanging from her belt. The museum describes her as a kind of mascot for the company, and links the chicken's claws to the symbols of the arquebusiers.
spoken_text: Look closely at The Night Watch. Behind the captain is a small, bright figure: a girl with a chicken hanging from her belt. The museum describes her as a kind of mascot for the company, and links the chicken's claws to the symbols of the arquebusiers.
phonemes: lˈʊk klˈoʊsli æt ðə nˈaɪt wˈɑːtʃ. bᵻhˌaɪnd ðə kˈæptɪn ɪz ɐ smˈɔːl, bɹˈaɪt fˈɪɡjɚ: ɐ ɡˈɜːl wɪð ɐ tʃˈɪkɪn hˈæŋɪŋ fɹʌm hɜː bˈɛlt. ðə mjuːzˈiəm dᵻskɹˈaɪbz hɜːɹ æz ɐ kˈaɪnd ʌv mˈæskɑːt fɚðə kˈʌmpəni, ænd lˈɪŋks ðə tʃˈɪkɪnz klˈɔːz tə ðə sˈɪmbəlz ʌvðɪ ˈɑːɹkwɪbˌɪzɪɹz.
